attBesluta.text: Ordered Sept 18th and arrived as scheduled in excellent condition. These torque wrenches work perfectly. I use the tools to maintain my ultralight aircraft. Unbeatable quality for the price Highly recommend them.

Belle qualité, beaucoup de possibilité de couple avec ses 3 clés, facile à régler, même si les écritures sont petites. Bien la valise de rangement. Je recommande pour son bon rapport qualité prix. Utiliser pour un 2 roues pour resserer les vis après demontage roue, fourche, frein.

Excellent matériel, très bien fini et pratique d'emploi avec une très large gamme d'utilisation grçace aux 3 modèles 1/4;3/8 et 1/2. Et avantage supplémentaire pour les personnes qui n'utilisent pas le matériel quotidiennement: Pas de numérique => pas de piles et pas de pannes. J'ai juste acheter en complément les adaptateurs pour le 3/8" car mes douilles et cliquets sont en 1/4" et 1/2"
Dokręcanie kół w samochodzie i motorach. Dokręcanie innych drobnych śrub i nakrętek idealne. Wyglądają na solidne. Mam nadzieję że długo posłużą.
I am glad that i have gotten this set. It covers torque ranges that my other doesn't and let me tell you. I have put it through it's paces. Awesome Tools
The bigger wrench handle is pretty short but it appears to work. It’s just tough to get enough torque on such a short handle.

Perfect for what I needed and they're attractive as well! I have 3 mischievous cats and needed to be able to block off my kitchen when I'm not home to supervise them. These folding room dividers work perfectly. They're light weight enough but also sturdy and the hinges bend both ways so their position can easily be changed. I've attached them to doorways by hinges so I can easily open and close them as needed. Thank you for a perfect solution!

Consegna veloce e imballaggio fatto bene. Lo sto usando per dividere le zone della casa per non fare entrare le mie gatte in alcune stanze pure tenendole aperte e mantenendo l'areazione dei locali,e funziona! Unico difetto, i pannelli lasciano perdere un po' il colore bianco,come se non fosse fissato bene

This divider met my needs. I had to add pads to the feet as I have laminate and the paint scraped off of the divider onto my floor. Works fine now. It is semi- private and will add some matetial onto the panel for extra privacy. I like the design and it is functional.
